newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, weekly rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, weekly rates fall.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a liquid end-of-week private sector market on Thursday to between 8-1/2 and nine percent from 9-1/8 and 9-7/8 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
One-week rates also fell to between 8/1-2 and 9-1/4 percent against a range of 9-1/2 to 9-3/4, they added.
One banker said the market was more liquid than usual for a Thursday because the Central Bank had accepted a low volume of bids in its 91-day treasury bill auction on Wednesday
The bank had asked for 700 million pounds and accepted bids for 761.75 million, rejecting bids for 881.75 million. Bills worth 768.525 million mature on Thursday.
Bankers said they had the impression that this time the bank had not discriminated against T-bill bids from non-residents, unlike in Monday's auction of 182-day bills.
By favouring local banks in the auction, the central bank helped push interbank pound rates up on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Public-sector banks kept their rates steady at 10-1/2 percent on Thursday.
